title: per-chapter-slides phase never triggered for manually-processed books
description: Books where per-chapter authoring was done manually (outside chapter_driver.py) never reach the per-chapter-slides phase in chapter_driver.py, so slide decks are never generated. Compounded by a second gap: generate_slide_decks.py requires episode-chapter-map.json which is also never written for manually-processed books, causing a silent error rather than a fallback.
root_cause: chapter_driver.py drives both per-chapter authoring AND per-chapter-slides in a single execution path. When orchestrator state stalls before reaching chapter_driver.py (or when chapters were authored manually), the slide phase is bypassed entirely. No independent check verifies that slide decks exist at finalize time.
fix_applied: generate_slide_decks.py and assemble_bundle.py: added _derive_episode_map_from_chapters() fallback — when episode-chapter-map.json is absent, auto-derives the mapping from chapters/ directory and writes the JSON for future callers. Retroactive: generated slide decks for ayyuhal-walad manually.
follow_up: Add a G-gate check in validate_ship_ready.py: if slide-decks/ is empty or missing, block finalize with a clear message. This ensures the gap is caught before publish even if chapter_driver.py was never called.
